name: avleon-monorepo
description: Source for @avleon/core, @avleon/cli and the Avleon docs site

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix packages/core && npm ci --prefix packages/cli && npm ci --prefix docs
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix packages/core && npm run build --prefix packages/cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix packages/core && npm run typecheck --prefix packages/cli
scripts.test: npm test --prefix packages/core && npm test --prefix packages/cli
